text:
lucy nguyen: kicking off canary deploy for release/2.14.0 to prod-canary now :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary rollout started (10% -> 25%), route: west1, step=1
ci-runner-bot: all pipeline jobs passed for commit bb12ef (unit/integration/infra-smoke)
lucy nguyen: seeing a deploy-bot error in the control plane, it retried but now stuck on blob lock acquire
deploy-bot: ERROR: failed to acquire cache lock for artifact group 'shared-build-cache' after 3 attempts, code=LOCK_TIMEOUT
raj patel: same here, our build artifacts are on the shared blobstore, looks like a cross-project lease collision
sasha kim: logs from the runner:
```
2025-11-05T14:02:11Z ERROR locker: lease acquire failed: resource busy
2025-11-05T14:02:11Z INFO retrying in 200ms
2025-11-05T14:02:12Z ERROR locker: lease acquire failed: resource busy
2025-11-05T14:02:13Z FATAL unable to fetch artifact: checksum mismatch maybe partial write
```

marta: this is blocking the canary promotion; if we continue we risk routing traffic to instances missing layers
lucy nguyen: we should decide: wait for locker to free, or abort canary and roll back to stable tag v2.13.9
raj patel: quick impact check: ~3% of prod requests hit canary currently, but some downstream jobs depend on the new embedder binary layer - mismatch causes 502s
sasha kim: suggestion: abort canary, pin the image to the previous digest, open a postmortem on cache lease logic
marta: agreed. also schedule a short change-window during next maintenance slot (UTC 03:00-03:30) for reattempt after we clear the blob leases
lucy nguyen: command to pin back (tested in staging):
```bash
redwoodctl rollout cancel --rollout-id=rb-2054321987-canary
redwoodctl promote --to=stable --image=registry.redwood.internal/release/2.13.9@sha256:9a7b4c3d
```

deploy-bot: rollback command executed by lucy nguyen, canary aborted, routing reverted to stable (v2.13.9)
ci-runner-bot: archived failing artifact metadata to s3://redwood-artifact-ops/2054321987/ for investigation
raj patel: I'll own the follow-up: will add a short test to assert lease ownership and add a faster backoff in locker acquires
sasha kim: also let's update release notes draft to mention deploy aborted due to artifact lock, and call out that no customer-facing downtime occurred
marta: tagging infra and eng-runtime for postmortem: @eng-infra @eng-runtime
lucy nguyen: thanks all — reopening the PR to revert the rollout annotation and will re-run during maintenance window once locker fix and artifact re-publish are confirmed :thumbsup:
